## MedplumClientOptions.logLevel property

Log level for requests and responses. - 'none': No logging (default) - 'basic': Log method, URL, and status code only (no sensitive headers) - 'verbose': Log all details including headers (may include sensitive data like tokens)

**Signature:**

```typescript
logLevel?: ClientLogLevel;
```
